description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the Hobby plan ($3/mo) or the Pro plan ($15/mo), tied to the token. Inputs: plan (hobby or pro), token, optional how_heard (at most 200 characters, stored on the owner), and optional upgrade_trigger (custom_domain_limit when this follows a custom-domain plan limit, otherwise manual). The call does not charge; payment happens on the returned Checkout page.

how_heard.description: Optional note, at most 200 characters. Stored on the owner.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

upgrade_trigger.description: custom_domain_limit when the domain limit sent you here. Otherwise manual.

name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get a paid-plan checkout link
